publicSources.observation: A dealer-image URL was observed, but the image host timed out; no inaccessible image is claimed as an obtained original.

researchConclusion: Bounded public checks did not yield usable distinct dealer artwork. Generic text banners or unavailable image-host URLs do not prove that the dealer has no logo. This artwork is clearly an independent proposal.

generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished independent UK motor dealer identity proposal. Transparent background, flat crisp graphic, no mockup, no gradients, no shadows, no raster distress or speckles. Wide horizontal lockup, simple isolated compact emblem on left and exact business name on right with plenty of transparent gap for cropping. Emblem legible at32px, thick clean geometry, no tiny details. Design a dual-contrast outline of clean white and deep navy around every shape so it works on white, dark charcoal #111113 and red #c40101. Two-line wordmark, tight readable bold geometric letterforms, no tagline, no extra text. Business name TECNO MOTORS. Left emblem a compact T whose horizontal cap has two short split bars suggesting precise engineering, not a cross or religious symbol. Deep navy with clear emerald #129776 accent and white keyline. TECNO in bold exact letters on line one, MOTORS below. No roof silhouette, no shield, no extra lettering.

compactDerivation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand, derive compact logo. Reproduce ONLY the isolated emblem on the far left of the reference, omitting the adjacent business wordmark entirely. Keep exactly the same motif, lettering inside the emblem, colour palette, navy and white outlines and proportions. Center this one compact emblem on a generous square transparent canvas, no other objects or words. Strengthen only tiny outline irregularities so the emblem is perfectly smooth and clear at32px. Flat crisp graphic, absolutely no speckles, no distressed pixels, no shadows, no gradients, no new geometry or creative changes.

surfaceReview.method: Exact pipeline alpha-padding crop and resize of actual generated surface artwork. Separate light-ink generated wordmark is used on dark and accent surfaces. Compact inputs are documented actual imagegen outputs or isolated lossless crops.
surfaceReview.review: Visually reviewed the exact pipeline cropTransparentPadding exports at 120 px and 180 px wordmark widths and 32 px and 64 px compact sizes against all six required background colours. Spelling and transparency checked. Filled light wordmarks improve contrast on dark surfaces; artwork colours do not change template palettes.
